text: ポケモンが　１ぴきしか　いないようだな

structure.jp: ポケモンが　１ぴきしか　いないようだな
structure.en: it looks like you have only one Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.explanation: しか together with a 'not' verb means 'only', with a feeling that it is too few. １ぴきしか　いない = 'there is only one'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ says 'it looks like', judging from what the speaker sees. いないようだ = 'it seems there isn't'.
